references.text: The same chapter describes the context of the plunder taken, including women, children, and livestock as war booty from the Midianites.
The continuation of the action where the plunder and captives are brought to Moses and the congregation at the plains of Moab.
Instructions to count the plunder of people and livestock, referring back to what was taken in verse 11.
A detailed list of the plunder taken, including small livestock, cattle, donkeys, and young women.
The law of war booty allowing the Israelites to take women, children, livestock, and everything else in the city as plunder.
A similar command to Joshua to take plunder and livestock from Ai as war booty.
The Israelites took all the plunder and livestock from the cities they conquered as war booty.
